import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 20;
    static final int MAXV = 2 * MAXN * MAXN; // 800
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static char[][] A, B;
    static int[][] zombieDist;
    static int N, limitT;
    static final int[] mvx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static final int[] mvy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static DinicFlow net;

    static boolean passable(char c) { return c >= '0' && c <= '9'; }
    static boolean positiveDigit(char c) { return c >= '1' && c <= '9'; }

    static class DinicFlow {
        ArrayList<Integer>[] adj;
        int[][] cap;
        int[] level;
        int[] ptr;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        DinicFlow() {
            adj = new ArrayList[MAXV];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXV; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            cap = new int[MAXV][MAXV];
            level = new int[MAXV];
            ptr = new int[MAXV];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            adj[u].add(v);
            adj[v].add(u);
            cap[u][v] = c;
            cap[v][u] = 0;
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int v : adj[u]) {
                    if (cap[u][v] > 0 && level[v] == -1) {
                        level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int t, int flow) {
            if (u == t) return flow;
            for (int &i = ptr[u]; i < adj[u].size(); ++i) {
                int v = adj[u].get(i);
                if (cap[u][v] > 0 && level[v] == level[u] + 1) {
                    int pushed = dfs(v, t, Math.min(flow, cap[u][v]));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        cap[u][v] -= pushed;
                        cap[v][u] += pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int ans = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                int pushed;
                while ((pushed = dfs(s, t, INF)) > 0) ans += pushed;
            }
            return ans;
        }
    }

    static void zombieBfs(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            Arrays.fill(zombieDist[i], INF);
        zombieDist[sx][sy] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + mvx[d], ny = y + mvy[d];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N) continue;
                if (passable(A[nx][ny]) && zombieDist[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    zombieDist[nx][ny] = zombieDist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void sourceEdgeBuilder(int sx, int sy) {
        int[][] distArr = new int[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) Arrays.fill(distArr[i], INF);
        distArr[sx][sy] = 0;

        if (positiveDigit(B[sx][sy]))
            net.addEdge(N * sx + sy, N * N + N * sx + sy, INF);

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + mvx[k], ny = y + mvy[k];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N) continue;
                if (distArr[nx][ny] != INF) continue;
                if (!passable(A[nx][ny])) continue;

                int arrive = distArr[x][y] + 1;
                if (arrive <= Math.min(zombieDist[nx][ny] - 1, limitT)) {
                    distArr[nx][ny] = arrive;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
                if (arrive <= Math.min(zombieDist[nx][ny], limitT) && positiveDigit(B[nx][ny]))
                    net.addEdge(N * sx + sy, N * N + N * nx + ny, INF);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        limitT = sc.nextInt();
        A = new char[N][N];
        B = new char[N][N];
        zombieDist = new int[N][N];
        net = new DinicFlow();

        int zx = 0, zy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                A[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (A[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    zx = i; zy = j;
                } else if (positiveDigit(A[i][j])) {
                    net.addEdge(MAXV - 2, i * N + j, A[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        zombieBfs(zx, zy);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                B[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (positiveDigit(B[i][j]))
                    net.addEdge(N * N + i * N + j, MAXV - 1, B[i][j] - '0');
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
                if (positiveDigit(A[i][j])) sourceEdgeBuilder(i, j);

        System.out.println(net.maxFlow(MAXV - 2, MAXV - 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
